physicsNotes: Matching atomic species do not imply that vibrating one local sample makes every matching atom on Earth respond through entanglement.
NQR is a local spectroscopic phenomenon for suitable quadrupolar nuclei and does not by itself provide global atom-to-atom addressing.
Any claimed global sensing, localization or counter-resonance capability requires independent experimental evidence.
